module: MCP vehicle tools: list, detail, JBeam files and part tree, physics instability log, reset/reload of the player vehicle, reading and writing the pose (position + rotation).
notes: get_instability clears the buffer after reading, unless clear=false; the log keeps 50 events maximum ({time, vid, jbeam}).
get_position/set_position use the rotation as a quaternion {x,y,z,w} computed with quatFromDir(direction, up); set_position goes through spawn.safeTeleport (teleports and repairs).
reset_vehicle and reload_vehicle only concern player 0's vehicle (no id argument).

onInstabilityDetected.desc: Engine hook (relayed by mcp_tools) called when the physics detects an unstable vehicle: appends {time, vid, jbeam} to shared.instabilityLog (50 max).

get_vehicles.desc: Lists the spawned vehicles: id, jbeam, display name (brand + name).

get_vehicle.desc: Details: id, jbeam, name, configKey, pcFile, position, speed (m/s).

returns.desc: true if the vehicle does not exist.

get_vehicle_files.desc: Files used: vehicleDirectory, directoriesLoaded, pcFile and sorted list of the JBeam files of the active parts (jbeam/io getPart).

get_part_tree.desc: Parts config as a table slot path -> chosen part name (flattened config.partsTree).

get_instability.desc: Returns the logged physics instabilities and clears the buffer by default.

reset_vehicle.desc: Resets/repairs the player vehicle in place (be:resetVehicle(0)).

returns.desc: true if there is no player vehicle.

reload_vehicle.desc: Reloads the player vehicle from disk (core_vehicle_manager.reloadVehicle(0)), which re-reads its JBeam.

returns.desc: true if there is no player vehicle.

get_position.desc: Pose of a vehicle: pos {x,y,z} and quaternion rot {x,y,z,w}.

returns.desc: true if the vehicle does not exist.

set_position.desc: Teleports a vehicle to a pose via spawn.safeTeleport; rot optional (keeps the current heading).
